subject.title: [Feature]: Configurable batching/aggregation of outbound Telegram notifications

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in outbound Telegram notification digest policy, and if so should it live in the Telegram plugin or in a shared outbound notification policy seam?
rationale: The request adds new config, delayed delivery, severity/media/thread grouping, and durability semantics; source inspection shows no missing narrow bug fix, only a product/API choice with compatibility implications.

options.title: Design shared digest policy first
options.body: Approve a bounded design for digest eligibility, urgent bypass, media/thread behavior, SQLite durability, and Telegram integration before implementation.

options.title: Keep only current mitigations
options.body: Leave outbound notifications immediate and rely on existing streaming/progress suppression, inbound debounce, queueing, and Telegram throttling without adding digest batching.

options.title: Telegram-plugin-only experiment
options.body: Allow a narrow opt-in Telegram plugin implementation, accepting that later cross-channel digest semantics may need refactoring.

recommendation.title: Design shared digest policy first
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded design for digest eligibility, urgent bypass, media/thread behavior, SQLite durability, and Telegram integration before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history signal across Telegram outbound, core delivery, and the config-sensitive review boundary for this feature.
